name: YJ Meta3 3x3 (8-Magnet Ball-Core + UV)
description: The YJ Meta3 3x3 (8-Magnet Ball-Core + UV) balances performance and design with an 8-magnet ball-core for a consistent magnetic feel and a UV-coated surface for durability and grip. Like the other Meta3 models, it features center skirts with edge cut-outs and sharper corner cap tips, giving you a puzzle that’s both precise and reliable.
